title: Select All Columns from Products
description: Write a SQL query to select all columns for all records from the 'Products' table.
expected_schema: CREATE TABLE Products (ProductID INT PRIMARY KEY, ProductName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, SupplierID INT, CategoryID INT, Unit VARCHAR(255), Price DECIMAL(10, 2));
sample_data: INSERT INTO Products (ProductID, ProductName, SupplierID, CategoryID, Unit, Price) VALUES (1, 'Chais', 1, 1, '10 boxes x 20 bags', 18.00), (2, 'Chang', 1, 1, '24 - 12 oz bottles', 19.00), (3, 'Aniseed Syrup', 1, 2, '12 - 550 ml bottles', 10.00);

title: Select Specific Columns with Filter
description: Write a SQL query to select the 'ProductName' and 'Price' columns for all products from the 'Products' table where the 'CategoryID' is 1.
expected_schema: CREATE TABLE Products (ProductID INT PRIMARY KEY, ProductName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, SupplierID INT, CategoryID INT, Unit VARCHAR(255), Price DECIMAL(10, 2));
sample_data: INSERT INTO Products (ProductID, ProductName, SupplierID, CategoryID, Unit, Price) VALUES (1, 'Chais', 1, 1, '10 boxes x 20 bags', 18.00), (2, 'Chang', 1, 1, '24 - 12 oz bottles', 19.00), (3, 'Aniseed Syrup', 1, 2, '12 - 550 ml bottles', 10.00), (4, 'Chef Anton''s Cajun Seasoning', 2, 2, '48 - 6 oz jars', 22.00);
correct_query: SELECT ProductName, Price FROM Products WHERE CategoryID = 1;

title: List Products and Supplier Names
description: Write a SQL query to list the 'ProductName' and the 'SupplierName' from the 'Suppliers' table. Products and Suppliers are related by 'SupplierID'.
expected_schema: CREATE TABLE Products (ProductID INT PRIMARY KEY, ProductName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, SupplierID INT, CategoryID INT, Price DECIMAL(10,2)); CREATE TABLE Suppliers (SupplierID INT PRIMARY KEY, SupplierName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, Country VARCHAR(100));
sample_data: INSERT INTO Suppliers (SupplierID, SupplierName, Country) VALUES (1, 'Exotic Liquids', 'UK'), (2, 'New Orleans Cajun Delights', 'USA'); INSERT INTO Products (ProductID, ProductName, SupplierID, CategoryID, Price) VALUES (1, 'Chais', 1, 1, 18.00), (2, 'Chang', 1, 1, 19.00), (3, 'Aniseed Syrup', 1, 2, 10.00), (4, 'Chef Anton''s Cajun Seasoning', 2, 2, 22.00);
correct_query: SELECT p.ProductName, s.SupplierName FROM Products p JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID;
